text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx + tail latency for model variant v3-eu-quant (eu-west-1). Thresholds crossed: 5xx > 3% for 5m, p95 latency > 1200ms. Paging Kiran (oncall).
Kiran (oncall): acked. I'm on it, joining the call now.
Maria (eng-runtime): jumping in — I'm seeing a spike correlated with large-token requests (seq > 1024) to v3-eu-quant. Error logs show OOM-ish traces on some GPUs.
Kiran (oncall): good catch. Any customer-facing errors? Sam (support), do we have reports?
Sam (support): @kiran a couple of enterprise customers reported timeouts in the last 10 minutes, one case potentially causing downstream job retries. No widely-broadcast P1s yet.
Kiran (oncall): initial mitigation idea: soft-disable v3-eu-quant variant routing and roll traffic back to v3-stable-eu v3.1. Also apply emergency per-key quotas for heavy keys to limit burst. Thoughts?
Maria (eng-runtime): agree. v3-stable-eu is compatible and has been our fallback in past incidents. We can flip routing at the edge with the control plane. Recommend 30s canary to verify.
Alex (oncall-next): if you want me to take over after you, I can handle the followup.
Kiran (oncall): please standby, Alex. I'll perform the initial mitigation.
Kiran (oncall): running platform command to shift 100% of new traffic from v3-eu-quant -> v3-stable-eu (canary 30s).
Kiran (oncall): ```
# redwoodctl traffic-shift
redwoodctl variant route set --from v3-eu-quant --to v3-stable-eu:1.2 --weight 100 --canary 30s --reason "emergency: high 5xx & p95 latency"
```
Deploy Bot: :gear: Starting traffic change: route update submitted by kiran. Change ID: change_2291234567_a1.
Deploy Bot: :white_check_mark: Route update applied to control plane. Canary window started (30s).
Maria (eng-runtime): monitoring logs and GPU metrics. Early telemetry: p95 on stable stays ~420ms, 5xx at 0.2% for stable. Good sign.
Kiran (oncall): canary passed initial 30s. Promoting to 100% for new requests. Applying emergency quota to top 10 heavy API keys for 15m to reduce tokens-in-flight.
Kiran (oncall): ```
# emergency quotas
redwoodctl quota set --key api_key_42 --max-tokens-per-min 200 --duration 15m
redwoodctl quota bulk-set --keys-file /tmp/heavy_keys.txt --max-tokens-per-min 300 --duration 15m
```
Deploy Bot: :gear: Quotas applied. change_2291234567_q1.
SRE Bot: Observability: routing shift completed. Cluster load decreased on nodes previously serving v3-eu-quant. No immediate OOMs reported post-shift.
Maria (eng-runtime): digging into why v3-eu-quant started failing. Preliminary: kernel scheduler on that quantized runtime path regressed with recent kernel bump. We'll open a rollback for that runtime, but for now keeping variant off.
Kiran (oncall): additional mitigation: disable variant at control plane to prevent any automated fallback traffic back to it.
Kiran (oncall): ```
# disable variant
redwoodctl variant disable --model v3 --variant v3-eu-quant --reason "emergency disable: runtime instability" --retain-cache false
```
Deploy Bot: :warning: Variant disable initiated: change_2291234567_d1.
Deploy Bot: :white_check_mark: Variant v3-eu-quant disabled. No new allocations will be placed.
Sam (support): sending a short note to affected customers and status page team. Draft message: "We experienced increased error rates in EU region affecting a subset of model variant v3-eu-quant. Traffic has been moved to a stable variant; we are investigating. No action required from customers." Any additions?
Maria (eng-runtime): add: we are applying temporary per-key throttles to reduce retries; work to revert kernel bump is in progress. ETA for root cause: 2h.
Kiran (oncall): copy. Sam please post update on status.redwood.ai and @customers impacted list.
Sam (support): posted to status page and emailed 3 affected customers.
Alex (oncall-next): I'll take the 30m watch and handle any paging. Kiran, handoff to you?
Kiran (oncall): Handover: issue stabilized after routing shift & variant disable. Key actions performed: 1) traffic shifted to v3-stable-eu, 2) emergency per-key quotas applied, 3) disabled v3-eu-quant at control plane. Observability: 5xx dropped from 4.6% -> 0.3% in 10m, p95 from 1400ms -> 450ms. No data loss. Handoff to Alex.
Alex (oncall-next): ack, on deck. If anything looks noisy, escalate to Maria + eng-runtime.
Maria (eng-runtime): creating a rollback MR to revert the recent runtime kernel change and will run a small internal perf test before re-enabling the quantized variant. MR: github.com/redwood/runtime/merge/PR-4723.
Maria (eng-runtime): notes for post-incident: consider adding probe-runner for quantized path with long-context requests; baseline p95 and memory headroom checks.
SRE Bot: Logging incident timeline entry: incident_id=INC-2026-2291234567, mitigations=traffic-shift,variant-disable,per-key-quotas.
Kiran (oncall): closing the active page; monitoring continues. Will schedule a short blameless postmortem and link to PR.
Sam (support): thanks all — customers acknowledged the update and appreciated quick response.
Alex (oncall-next): leaving a note: if the rollback MR lands, coordinate a staged reenable with a 10m canary and increased observability (KV cache metrics + p99 mem-use).
Maria (eng-runtime): agreed. I'll coordinate reenable plan and post to #eng-runtime when ready.
Kiran (oncall): nice work team. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Pager resolved.
